entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:1
segments: Statutes and--judgments; the laws which God gave the Israelites concerning his worship and their social and civil duties.
Obedience to the laws of God is required by interest as well as by duty.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:2
segments: We should take the testimony of God in his word as he has given it, and not be disposed in any respect to alter it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:3
segments: What the Lord did;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:4
segments: God often makes a difference in this world between the righteous and the wicked, and shows by his providence that godliness with contentment is great gain.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:6
segments:
This is your wisdom and your understanding; it would promote their reputation for wisdom and understanding among other nations. 
 
Obedience to God is the height of human wisdom, and all who neglect his commandments are guilty of the greatest folly.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:10
segments:
vv 10-13. 
 
  In Horeb;

The object of God in the revelation of himself, is not only to lead the present generation to love and serve him, but also to communicate a knowledge of his will to their children and children's children, and thus perpetuate to all generations a people to his praise.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:14
segments: Statutes and judgments;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:16
segments: Men are strongly inclined to corrupt themsleves by worshipping idols; serving the creature and neglecting the Creator.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:19
segments: God hath divided; he had given the benefit of the heavenly bodies to all nations, as well as to the Israelites.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:20
segments:
The iron furnace; the great oppression and hardship of their state of bondage. 
 
  A people of inheritance; his peculiar people, and heirs of his favor.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:22
segments: This land;
True benevolence will teach a man earnestly to desire and diligently to labor, that blessings of which he is deprived may, if consistent, be given to others.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:23
segments: The covenant;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:24
segments: Consuming fire--a jealous God; one who is greatly displeased with those who give to others what is due only to himself; and if they do not repent, will destroy them.  De 4.26

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:31
segments: The covenant;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:34
segments:
Assayed; attempted. 
 
  Temptations; trials; the mighty works of God, intended to prove the faith of his people.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:36
segments: His great fire;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:41
segments: Severed; set apart.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:48
segments: Sion; called also Sirion, which was another name for Hermon.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 4:49
segments: Sea of the plain; the Dead sea.
